newsitem.title: USA: Susquenita School District, Pa., final details.
newsitem.headline: Susquenita School District, Pa., final details.

text.p: Public Financial Management, Inc, financial advisor for Susquenita School District, Pa., said it adjusted the total amount of the District's general obligation bond issue and recalculated Prudential Securities Inc's winning bid. The issue is now $5.425 million and Prudential's true interest cost is 5.267 percent reflecting the cost of bond insurance, not the 5.239 percent originally calculated.
